capabilities.purpose: Validate harness configuration and maintain engineering progress with revision checks.
prerequisites: Dependencies from requirements.txt installed in the selected interpreter
capabilities.failure_behavior: Report the interpreter or dependency failure; do not claim validation or progress persistence succeeded.

capabilities.purpose: Inspect the existing Python backend and Odoo app, and edit only explicitly assigned owning repositories.
prerequisites: Repository bindings resolve through harness.json and optional harness.local.json
Host permission and task scope permit the intended operation
capabilities.failure_behavior: Record the missing path or denied operation and continue independent harness work; never substitute a new application codebase here.

capabilities.purpose: Launch a development session and delegate bounded explorer, implementer and reviewer tasks.
prerequisites: Project configuration trusted and supported by the active host
capabilities.failure_behavior: Show a dry-run command or report the unavailable host feature; use the same development loop without pretending subagents ran.

capabilities.purpose: Load session context, preserve sanitized checkpoints and validate handoffs at configured lifecycle events.
prerequisites: Exact current hook definitions reviewed and trusted through /hooks
capabilities.failure_behavior: Run explicit helper checks and record checkpoints manually; do not bypass trust or claim hooks are active.

capabilities.purpose: Read the linked shared and role specifications and refresh source provenance when requested.
prerequisites: Relevant connected read tool available in this session
Connection authorized for the requested pages
capabilities.failure_behavior: Use recorded local snapshots with their dates and limitations; identify a required refresh without inventing current remote content.

capabilities.purpose: Verify current Codex, Odoo, AssemblyAI and AWS interfaces before relying on them.
prerequisites: An available documentation connector or allowed web access
Primary documentation relevant to the actual version and task
capabilities.failure_behavior: Retain source dates and material uncertainty; do not invent APIs or report unverified integration behavior.

capabilities.purpose: Verify explicitly assigned application changes against Odoo, AssemblyAI or model providers.
prerequisites: Authorized live test scope and suitable test data
capabilities.failure_behavior: Run appropriate offline checks and label live checks not_run; never substitute mock evidence for a live result.

capabilities.purpose: Prepare and later verify the backend ECS Fargate pipeline in the application repository.
prerequisites: Reviewable application pipeline and infrastructure artifacts
capabilities.failure_behavior: Keep prepared artifacts distinct from deployment; record the missing prerequisite and do not create cloud resources during harness setup.
